Data:Craft.raggedcrossroads tincture.lab.Label: Craft: Labhitic Tincture
Data:Craft.raggedcrossroads tincture.lab.StartDescription: Focus my own and local resources to create a small quantity of a stable Edge ingredient. (Or for a Scholar-level recipe: add something with a Memory aspect, and I have the makings of a significant Edge Memory.)
Data:Craft.raggedcrossroads tincture.lab.Desc: As it clarifies, the Tincture vibrates judderingly. This is called 'growling'.

Data:Craft.resurgences.emergences music..Label: Craft: Beguiling Melody
Data:Craft.resurgences.emergences music..StartDescription:
Conceive or recall a delightful little music. 

[Resurgences & Emergences with Prentice-level <sprite name=grail> creates Beguiling Melody. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I add Fabric, I can hum the faintest life into a little cloth doll.]
Data:Craft.resurgences.emergences music..Desc: I'll be humming this for a while. And so will anyone else who happens by.

Data:Craft.resurgences.emergences tangle.Label: Craft: Tanglebrag

[Resurgences & Emergences with Prentice-level <sprite name=moth> creates Tanglebrag. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I nestle an Egg into the knot, I'll hatch something eyeless, but pulsing with potential.]
Data:Craft.resurgences.emergences tangle.Desc: Set it down softly, or it might roll away, even uphill.

Data:Craft.sacralimiae material.westcott.Label: Craft: Westcott's Compounds
Data:Craft.sacralimiae material.westcott.StartDescription:
The Ordo Limiae taught how to prepare Forgeful compounds from ephemeral materials - 'the Moth finds the Flame'. 

[Sacra Limiae with Prentice-level <sprite name=moth> creates Westcott's Compounds. Or for a Scholar-level recipe:  if I include a Memory and smoke the preparation while it's fresh, I'll gain a riddlesome insight.]
Data:Craft.sacralimiae material.westcott.Desc: The common name now is 'Westcott's Compounds', but the Ordo Limiae is older than Westcott by… quite some centuries. Probably. Westcott wasn't Long as far as anyone ever knew.

Data:Craft.scholar.anbary.lapidary liqui.Label: Craft: Iotic Essence

[Anbary & Lapidary with Scholar-level <sprite name=forge>, plus Liquid, creates Iotic Essence.]
Data:Craft.scholar.anbary.lapidary liqui.Desc: [With Keeper-level Forge, Iotic Essence is the precursor to the Great Ink called Orpiment Exultant; with Keeper-level Lantern, it can become Xanthotic Essence instead.]
